newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: SanMig to merge Monterey with property unit.
newsitem.headline: SanMig to merge Monterey with property unit.

text.p: Food and beverage conglomerate San Miguel Corp said on Thursday its board had approved a plan to spin-off the meat and poultry businesses from its subsidiary Monterey Farms Corp and merge Monterey with its property subsidiary.

"The board approved the proposal to spin-off the meat and livestock business of Monterey Farms Corp, a San Miguel subsidiary," senior vice-president and assistant corporate secretary Emmanuel Javelosa told the Philippine Stock Exchange.
He added it also approved a plan to merge Monterey and San Miguel Properties Philippines Inc, another subsidiary.
The merger plan still has to be ratified by shareholders of both Monterey and San Miguel Properties in separate special stockholders' meeting.
Details of the plan were not immediately available.
Monterey, a listed but inactive company, is primarily engaged in the agriculture and fishing industry. It was last traded on April 22 at 90 pesos each.

San Miguel recently said it had plans to re-develop its headquarters complex into a mixed-use office, residential and commercial complex. Its main office sits on a prime lot in Manila's alternative Ortigas business district.
